title: Guess Who / Le Bal Masque - island exterior source assets (offline generated)
regenerate: V:\ComfyUI\ComfyUI\ComfyUI\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -I gen\build_all.py  (run from island_src; stages alone: gen\gen_meshes.py, gen\gen_textures.py, gen\gen_audio.py [names])

conventions.units_axes: UE centimetres, Z up. +X = north (downwind), +Y = east. Wind blows from -X toward +X.
conventions.obj: Same convention as Tools/level/gen_arch_meshes.py: 'v x -y z', 'vn nx -ny nz' (UE values with y negated); faces wound so the geometric normal in OBJ space points outward (checked per face against the smooth normals and by signed volume for closed meshes). Indexed v/vt/vn, smooth per-vertex normals, one object per file, no materials/usemtl.
conventions.uv: Island: world xy / 400. Sea grid: world xy / 1000 (local; equals world if placed at x=y=0). Boulders, crowns, bushes: per-face box projection, cm / 100 (1 UV per metre). Trees: u wraps the trunk (2 tiles trunk, 1 on branches), v = length along the limb / 100.
conventions.normal_maps: Tangent space, +Z blue, OpenGL convention (green = +Y = up in the image). UE uses DirectX: tick 'Flip Green Channel' when importing T_GW_SeaNormal, T_GW_RainGlass, T_GW_Rock_Normal.
conventions.textures: 8-bit PNG. BaseColor maps are sRGB; every other map is linear data (turn sRGB off). All tile seamlessly (periodic noise, wrapped stamping, wrap-mode filters; seam statistics checked).
conventions.audio: WAV PCM 16-bit, 48000 Hz, mono, peak-normalised to -3.0 dBFS, no clipped samples. Loops are synthesised circularly (FFT-filtered periodic noise, periodic envelopes, closed phase tracks, events wrapped modulo the loop), so the tail flows into the head like any two adjacent samples.

SM_GW_Island.purpose: Heightfield island in world coordinates (place at origin, no rotation/scale): plateau under the manor (z -45 +-15, <= -40 inside the footprint + 100 cm), irregular plateau edge 1200..2600 cm from the footprint (wider north/east = lawn beyond the conservatory), steep rugged cliffs with ledges down to the sea at z -2000, rocky shore band -2000..-2150, sea bed falling to -2600 at the grid border.
SM_GW_Island.pivot: world origin (mesh authored in world coordinates)

SM_GW_Boulder_A.purpose: Shore / cliff-foot boulder, rounded. Noise-displaced icosphere with fractured facets, flat base.
SM_GW_Boulder_A.pivot: base centre, z 0 at the bottom

SM_GW_Boulder_B.pivot: base centre, z 0 at the bottom

SM_GW_Boulder_C.pivot: base centre, z 0 at the bottom

SM_GW_SeaGrid.purpose: Flat sea surface grid for vertex wave displacement in the material; place at z -2000.

SM_GW_TreeBent_A.purpose: Wind-bent coastal tree, cypress-like (tall, leaning from the base, crown pushed downwind). Trunk and branches only; put SM_GW_Crown_* at crown_anchors_ue.
SM_GW_TreeBent_A.note: trunk base at origin on the ground (z=0); the trunk continues 40 cm below ground (z=-40) to sit on uneven terrain

SM_GW_TreeBent_B.purpose: Wind-bent coastal tree, pine-like (crooked dogleg trunk, flat top). Trunk and branches only.
SM_GW_TreeBent_B.note: trunk base at origin on the ground (z=0); the trunk continues 40 cm below ground (z=-40) to sit on uneven terrain

SM_GW_Crown_A.purpose: Lumpy foliage blob for branch tips (flat-ish underside, streamed toward +X).

SM_GW_Bush_A.purpose: Low lumpy coastal shrub, top swept toward +X.
SM_GW_Bush_A.pivot: base centre, z 0 at the bottom

SM_GW_Bush_B.pivot: base centre, z 0 at the bottom

T_GW_SeaNormal.purpose: Sea ripple normal map: ~60 directional choppy wave components travelling along +U (wind), group modulation and capillary chop. Linear (sRGB off), OpenGL green-up.

T_GW_SeaFoam.purpose: Foam mask: whitecaps on the highest crests with trailing foam, long wind streaks along U, bubbly breakup. Mostly dark. Linear.

T_GW_Clouds.purpose: Storm-cloud density (white = dense cloud, dark = thin gaps), billowy, high contrast. Linear.

T_GW_RainStreaks.purpose: Falling-rain streak sheet: thin vertical streaks of varying length and brightness on black, brighter toward the falling head (bottom). Linear.

T_GW_RainGlass.purpose: Window-pane rain normal map: drops of all sizes plus short running rivulets (thin beaded trails that wipe the drops, heavy head drop at the bottom of the image). Linear, OpenGL green-up; flat areas = (128,128,255).

T_GW_RainGlassMask.purpose: Coverage mask of the same drops and rivulets (white = water). Linear.

T_GW_Rock_BaseColor.purpose: Dark wet grey-brown cliff rock: irregular strata bands, wandering block joints and fine cracks, vertical water staining, cavity darkening. sRGB.

T_GW_Rock_Normal.purpose: Normal map matching T_GW_Rock_BaseColor (same height field). Linear, OpenGL green-up.

T_GW_Grass_BaseColor.purpose: Dark wind-flattened coastal grass: ~34k painted blades lying along +U with a swirling flow, dull green / olive / straw patches over dark thatch. sRGB.

thunder_1.purpose: Close strike: hard broadband crack with secondary snaps, tearing crackle and low thump, then a heavy rolling rumble that decays.

thunder_2.purpose: Mid-distance strike: softer crack, long rolling rumble with many bursts that come and go.

thunder_3.purpose: Distant thunder: no crack, slow swell, deep muffled roll.

rain_loop.purpose: Heavy rain bed: hiss + body, dense far patter, closer ticks, ~10 drips. Seamless loop.

wind_loop.purpose: Storm wind: band-passed noise with slow gusts (12-14 dB swings, brighter in gusts) and a faint howl (two narrow resonances gliding with the gusts). Seamless loop.

sea_loop.purpose: Rough surf on rocks: steady low rumble and wash, 5 wave crashes 4..8 s apart (swell, impact, crash, backwash fizz). Seamless loop.

notes_and_deviations: Trees: the trunk continues 40 cm below the pivot (straight down to z -40, plus the closing cap, bbox min z about -53) so the tree can sit on uneven ground without floating. The pivot is still the trunk base at ground level.
Island shore band: rock noise is clamped to -2150..-1992, so a few shore rock tops sit up to 8 cm above the -2000 sea level (they break the surf); otherwise the band is -2000..-2150.

Island normals: every face points up (true heightfield); 'normal_face_disagree' counts the few faces on sharp crags whose smooth vertex normals lean away from the face normal (shading only, not flipped faces).

Loops are seamless by construction (circular synthesis) rather than by a tail-to-head crossfade; loop_seam_step_percentile is the percentile of the last->first sample step among all sample steps (a value well inside 0..100 = no click).
Texture seam_ratio = mean jump across the wrap seams / mean neighbour step (about 1.0 = seamless); sparse features (cracks, strata) crossing an edge can push it a little above 1.
